svg.title: Heartstone: Low-poly crystal facets
svg.desc: Heartstone (1D): resonance crafting in low-poly facets on a Stonekeeper's bench. Four crystal shards sit in a faceted ring setting; above each, a beat line shows how far its pitch is from the target chord at the top: a fast wobble is far, a slow one is close, and a straight line is right. One shard is cracked from earlier strikes, a fifth is being lifted from the tray below, and the row of hammers counts the strikes left.
